documentation.file_docstring: Browser Policy Editor — Templates & Client Logic Provides policy template data and client-side JavaScript for the browser-based governance dashboard policy editor. Vanilla JS only; no React, no build system. Output strings are embedded in script tags.
inline_comments: Returns a JSON string of the 5 policy templates for embedding as `window.__policyTemplates` in the browser page.
Returns client-side vanilla JS for the policy editor panel. Expects `window.__policyTemplates` to be set and the global `esc()` function to be available for HTML escaping.
